summary: Implemented the window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the SET_WINDOW_TITLE format entry producing ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and the Control.title classmethod with an Args docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor and set_alt_screen, checking only is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title) with the second item. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added section above Fixed linking pull request 2200. Tests were not run and nothing was committed, per instructions; verification was by reading only.
